text:
nina: follow-up on last night's alert deluge for /v1/embeddings — noise came from a burst of identical timeout traces across many clients. postmortem uploaded: https://redwood.internal/pm/IN-4972. we need quick wins: dedupe window, switch some alerts to rate-based, and tighten paging rules. volunteers?
ashok: i can handle dedupe. plan: 30s dedupe keyed by route+model+error_hash, add integration test that fires the same error repeatedly. aim to open PR by Mon EOD and rollout Tue morning.
rebeccah: i'll own thresholding. propose replacing raw-count alerts with errors-per-1m normalized by qps, run in staging for 48h. i'll create a dashboard tracking false positives and will set a 15% FP threshold for rollback. target: staging config by Tue and review Thu.
nina: paging policy suggestion: only page when either (a) >=3 distinct services report the same error in 5m OR (b) error-rate >0.5% for two consecutive minutes. i'll update the runbook and notify rotations.
pagerbot: Incident IN-4972 added by nina  notified #eng-oncall 2026-03-25T07:12:03Z
ashok: noted. i'll include a temporary global throttle for identical stack traces to avoid immediate storms.
rebeccah: will add an Optimize eval to measure missed true positives after threshold change.
nina: thanks. owners/tl;dr: ashok -> dedupe (PR Mon, rollout Tue), rebeccah -> thresholds (staging Tue, review Thu), nina -> paging/runbook (update Tue). i'll schedule a 3-week cadence: weekly Friday 10am check-ins to monitor alert volume and recurrence. update your tickets when changes go live.
